name: agent-ops-patterns
description: Operational patterns for running LLM agents in production: output-boundary secret redaction (JS + Python), scoped fail-closed capability grants, staleness-basis discipline, agent-memory integrity linting, recency×relevance rank fusion for recall, usage-scored memory-eviction evidence, command de-obfuscation for policy scans, shadow-screen gate states, comment-stripped presence guards, unknown-flag refusal for agent CLIs, pipe-proof RESULT verdict lines, fail-soft detector discipline, skill regression testing.
author: David Kooi
